description: This class defines a property editor for the Concept object in the OpenMRS framework, providing methods to serialize and deserialize Concept instances by ID or UUID.

classes.name: ConceptEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting between String identifiers and Concept objects, supporting ID and UUID retrieval.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Concept object by its numeric ID using the OpenMRS ConceptService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Concept object by its UUID string using the OpenMRS ConceptService.
